_meta.what: Prevalidated print-service geometry presets for BOOKSMITH. Single source of truth for per-service cover/interior geometry beyond KDP. Consumed by composite_cover.py, generate_book.js, verify_build.py (via preset_lookup.py).

provenance_codes.mixam-template: decoded from Mixam's own template-generator PDFs (Digest 5.5x8.5 Paperback spine 0.12 + US Trade 6x9 Paperback 'Reading Books' spine 0.51 + US Trade 6x9 Hardcover 'Novels' spine 0.60), MediaBoxes + printed callouts
provenance_codes.blurb-calculator-probe: probed live from Blurb's official booksize calculator (blurb.com/make/pdf_to_book/booksize_calculator), 2026-07-11
provenance_codes.INFERRED: not confirmed from an official source — verify at upload; service calculator/previewer is canonical

_meta.meta_rule: The service's own calculator/previewer ALWAYS beats these numbers. Presets make the FIRST pass land; a stated dimension from a rejection or calculator goes into book_config.spine.spine_override_in and wins.

kdp_paperback.interior: trim-size pages (6x9), no interior bleed for text books; mirror margins
kdp_paperback.barcode: KDP overlays its own ISBN barcode bottom-right of back panel; keep 2.25x1.5 in clear, bake nothing

kdp_hardcover.cover_model: single wrap with 0.708 in turn-in all sides (NOT bleed)
kdp_hardcover.spine: pages x per_page_white + 0.348 — NON-extrapolating across page-count bands (186pp needed 0.767 vs formula 0.706); reverse-derive from the Previewer's stated dims on rejection
kdp_hardcover.paper: white only (KDP offers no cream hardcover)

mixam_hardcover.cover_model: THREE separate PDFs: front_cover.pdf / back_cover.pdf / spine.pdf (filename keyword routing; bare back.pdf misroutes to body page 1). Template also offers a single-spread variant which adds a 0.40 in hinge allowance (flat 13.00 for 6x9 at 0.60 spine = 2x6 + 0.60 + 0.40) — PREFER the 3-panel form, proven by shipped books, no hinge modeling needed.
mixam_hardcover.interior_pages_accept: trim-size pages proven acceptable in shipped production (template nominal body page = trim + 2x0.125)
mixam_hardcover.spine: pages x per_page + board add; board add NON-constant (0.160 @204pp, 0.110 @548pp observed in shipped work) — Mixam job calculator canonical. Live-calculator series (US Trade cream 50lb): 68pp 0.31 / 100pp 0.38 / 200pp 0.61 / 300pp 0.84 / 400pp 1.06 / 500pp 1.29 -> fit spine ~= pages x 0.00228 + 0.154 in (single-source CALC; per-center offers varied ±0.05).
mixam_hardcover.hinge_note: 0.2 in hinge each side of the spine. Single panels: 0.8 bleed all edges but only 0.2 used at the hinge edge. Spread form: back + 0.2 + spine + 0.2 + front, then +0.8 bleed all round (spread grows 1.6 in W and H) — the 3-panel form avoids modeling this entirely.
mixam_hardcover.spine_file_bleed: 0.8 in TOP/BOTTOM only (none left/right); spine movement tolerance ±0.08 left-right; keep spine text 0.2 from top/bottom
mixam_hardcover.min_max_pages: Reading Books hardcover (cream 50/55/60lb): 68 - 916 interior pages; cover counts +2
mixam_hardcover.endpapers: automatic on every casebound book; white/black free; printed endpapers not offered
mixam_hardcover.barcode: Mixam does not auto-stamp a barcode

mixam_paperback.provenance: mixam-template + mixam-official (mixam.com/support/{filesetup,bleed,binding,pagecount} + /paperbackbooks) + live calculator/template API capture 2026-07-11
product_lines_seen: Reading Books (US Trade 6x9 — the text-book line)
mixam_paperback.cover_model: single wrap [back|spine|front] at 0.125 in bleed (KDP-wrap geometry, front on right; NO glue-gap added to the spread width), OR separate front/back panels + exact-width spine panel (spine file: 0.125 bleed TOP/BOTTOM ONLY). Wrap form: W = 2 x trim_w + spine + 0.25 ; H = trim_h + 0.25. Verified: template 6x9 @0.51 spine -> spread trim 12.51x9.00, with bleed 12.76x9.25; 5.5x8.5 @0.12 -> 11.37x8.75. Keep content clear of 0.125 in glue area both sides of the spine. No spine file uploaded -> spine prints blank.
mixam_paperback.interior_pages_accept: trim-size pages (matches shipped Mixam practice for text books; template nominal body page = trim + 2x0.125)
mixam_paperback.spine_fit: cream 50lb: spine ~= pages x 0.0023 + 0.04 in (fits the live-calculator series within ±0.005). Cream 55lb @200pp: 0.60; cream 60lb: 0.63; uncoated 40/50/60lb @200pp: 0.34/0.44/0.49. Per-print-center offers vary up to ±0.05 — the CART value is canonical; use spine_override_in for production.

page_multiple.provenance: CONFIRMED — calculator page slider step=4; multiple-of-4 rule published for perfect-bound (support/pagecount)

mixam_paperback.min_max_pages: Reading Books (cream 50/55/60lb): 32 - 916 interior pages. Cover counts +2 toward Mixam's total-page accounting.
mixam_paperback.spine_text_rule: keep spine content 0.2 in from top/bottom; blank spine below ~0.25 in width (kit rule; Mixam prints blank if no spine supplied)
mixam_paperback.barcode: not required (incl. PrintLink POD); if used: back cover bottom-right at 300dpi; Mixam does not auto-stamp

mixam_file_specs.pdf: print-ready PDF preferred (PDF 1.3 w/ PDF/X-1a:2001 compliance per Mixam's own Adobe export preset); uploads < 2 GB; TrimBox = final page size (bleed OUTSIDE it)
mixam_file_specs.color: CMYK preferred (RGB auto-converted, colors may shift); ICC GRACoL2006_Coated1v2; ink 150-250% recommended, 400% max TAC; rich black C30 M30 Y30 K100 for areas, 100K for small text
mixam_file_specs.resolution: 300 dpi standard; below 100 dpi rejected as unprintable
mixam_file_specs.fonts: embed all fonts (or convert to outlines — Mixam's stated safe path)
mixam_file_specs.naming: page files auto-sequenced from names (Page_1, page-1); cover.pdf / cover_spread.pdf auto-routed; keywords front/back/last recognized; kit's inner_* labeling is compatible (proven in shipped production, not doc-guaranteed)

blurb_trade.what: Blurb Trade Books (their bookstore-style text line). Papers: standard_trade_bw_matte_paper (Standard Trade B&W), economy_trade_matte_paper, standard_trade_matte_paper (color). Bindings probed: softcover, lithowrap (= Hardcover ImageWrap), hardcover (= Hardcover w/ DUST JACKET, 3.375 in flaps — captured but NOT implemented as a kit format).
blurb_trade.row_schema: [page_pdf_wxh, page_trim_wxh, page_bleed, page_safety(0.25), page_gutter_min(0.5), cover_pdf_wxh, cover_trim_wxh, cover_bleed, flap_wxh|none, spine_wxh, spine_safety(0.25)] — all inches; field labels for the two 0.25/0.5 constants are INFERRED, values exact
blurb_trade.not_offered: 8x10 hardcover/ImageWrap returns zeros from the calculator (softcover only at 8x10)
blurb_trade.page_bleed_model: page PDF = (trim_w + 0.125) x (trim_h + 0.25) — bleed on the OUTER width edge only (none into the binding) + both height edges. E.g. 6x9 -> 6.125 x 9.25.

page_count_range_probed.provenance: calculator accepted 24..480; exact service min/max INFERRED from that range — confirm at upload

spine_tables_in._note: spine depends ONLY on paper + page count (verified identical across trims). Linear-interpolate between points; calculator canonical. Softcover spines:

imagewrap_and_dustjacket._note: hardcover bindings share spine values; 0.25 board minimum below ~100pp

blurb_trade.softcover_cover_model: single wrap: W = 2 x trim_w + spine + 0.25 (0.125 bleed each side); H = trim_h + 0.25. Verified against every probed row (e.g. 6x9 @24pp bw: 12.306 x 9.25).
blurb_trade.imagewrap_cover_model: single wrap, cover_bleed 0.306; panels carry a wrap allowance beyond trim (cover_trim = 2 x (trim_w + allowance) + spine; allowance 0.319 @6x9/8x10, 0.333 @5x8); H = (trim_h + 0.249) + 0.612. DO NOT derive — interpolate cover_pdf W/H + spine directly from probed rows below.

imagewrap_cover_pdf_rows_6x9._schema: pages: [cover_pdf_w, cover_pdf_h, spine] inches, paper standard_trade_bw
imagewrap_cover_pdf_rows_6x9._100_note: 100pp row DERIVED: spine 0.319 evidenced by dustjacket-bw@100 (dustjacket==imagewrap spine verified at 200/480pp); W slides 1:1 with spine off the 200pp row (13.75 - 0.181). The raw 13.625/0.375 @100 belongs to the COLOR paper table.

imagewrap_cover_pdf_rows_6x9_color._schema: pages: [cover_pdf_w, cover_pdf_h, spine] inches, paper standard/economy color

blurb_trade.dustjacket_note: hardcover (dust jacket): flaps 3.375 x (trim_h + 0.5); jacket W e.g. 20.458 x 9.5 @6x9 100pp — captured for reference, not a kit format

file_specs.pdf_standard: INFERRED — Blurb PDF-to-Book historically PDF/X-3 sRGB 300dpi; confirm at upload
file_specs.barcode: INFERRED — Blurb applies its own barcode for bookstore distribution; keep back-cover bottom-right clear

blurb_trade.dense_spine_table_outcome: a dense probe (every 12pp, 24-480) was attempted 2026-07-11 but died to Blurb's rate limiter before writing. The six calculator-exact anchor points per paper above are the shipped basis — linear interpolation between anchors, Blurb's previewer canonical at upload. Re-probe politely (>=10s pacing, single session) only if sub-anchor precision ever matters.
